description: The Product Analyst role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the founders and directly shape product and business outcomes through data-driven insights. The ideal candidate is a first-principles thinker with strong analytical depth, a natural curiosity for uncovering patterns in data, and a relentless focus on solving complex business problems. If you enjoy challenging assumptions, translating ambiguity into actionable insights, and building scalable analytical frameworks in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role. Responsibilities Problem Discovery and Structuring: Partner closely with product, business, and growth teams to identify key business challenges and translate them into structured analytical problem statements. Insight Generation and Analysis: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle from data exploration and hypothesis creation to deep-dive analysis and actionable insight generation. Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage quantitative analysis to uncover trends, measure business impact, and provide strategic recommendations that influence product and business decisions. Product Analytics and Experimentation: Analyse user behaviour, product funnels, retention metrics, and growth levers to identify optimisation opportunities and support experimentation initiatives. Dashboarding and Visualisation: Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable teams to monitor key metrics and make informed decisions efficiently. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, engineers, operations, and leadership teams to solve complex business problems and drive product growth at scale. Data Excellence: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting systems and analytical workflows. Requirements Bachelor's degree from a top-tier college. 1-3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a similar analytical role, preferably in a high-growth B2C or consumer tech environment. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on ambiguous business problems. Strong curiosity about product behaviour, customer journeys, and business metrics. Hands-on experience with visualisation and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or QlikView. This job was posted by Shivani Goyal from GoodScore.
title: Product Analyst

description: Role: Business Analyst Location: Bengaluru, KA Years of Exp: 6+ Years About Ascendion Ascendion is a global digital engineering and AI services company helping organizations transform their businesses through technology, data, and artificial intelligence. Ascendion partners with leading enterprises to build and modernize digital products, technology platforms, and AI-powered solutions. With a strong focus on innovation, engineering excellence, and an AI-first approach, Ascendion helps clients accelerate digital transformation and deliver measurable business outcomes. Ascendion has a global delivery presence across the United States and India and serves clients across industries including Healthcare & Life Sciences, Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Retail, and Technology. About The Role We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our team and serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams. The Business Analyst will be responsible for understanding business needs, gathering and documenting requirements, analyzing business processes and data, and ensuring technology solutions align with organizational and client objectives. Key Responsibilities Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder discussions and requirement-gathering sessions. Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) by analyzing business processes, data, workflows, and stakeholder needs. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, IT teams, product teams, and other cross-functional teams. Translate business requirements into clear and actionable functional requirements for technology teams. Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement, optimization, and automation. Develop process flows, workflows, use cases, and other business analysis documentation as required. Participate in testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and solution validation activities. Identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and potential improvements during the requirement and implementation lifecycle. Required Skills Strong business analysis and analytical skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills. Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into structured requirements. Hands-on experience in requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation. Strong experience creating BRDs, functional requirements, process flows, and use cases. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
title: Business Analyst/BSA/Process Analyst

description: Product-led role | QA and delivery ownership | AI-enabled SDLC Location: Ireland/Northern Ireland Working model: Hybrid, combining office-based and remote working Experience: Typically 2–3 years' relevant experience Function: AI Product / Product Delivery Role type: Customer-facing product role with hands-on QA and delivery responsibility Salary: €50,000–€55,000 per annum Role purpose FlowForma is looking for an AI Product & Delivery Specialist to help take an emerging AI product from pilot and experimentation towards a scalable commercial offering. The primary focus of the role is Product: understanding customer problems, shaping requirements, prioritising what should be built and ensuring the resulting product meets those requirements. The role also owns quality and delivery through FlowForma's AI-led SDLC. You will act as the product and quality owner within that lifecycle – defining requirements, guiding work through the AI-enabled development process, validating outputs, testing thoroughly and driving releases through to production. Strong technical understanding is important, but this is not a traditional full-time software development role. We are looking for a product-minded person with strong QA discipline and enough technical capability to work confidently inside an AI-enabled delivery model. The role will contribute actively to product direction and own execution once priorities have been agreed by the product-direction group. What you will own Translate agreed product direction into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and a prioritised delivery backlog. Own day-to-day product delivery from definition through build, validation, testing, release and iteration. Act as the product and quality owner within FlowForma's AI-led SDLC, ensuring implementation aligns to requirements and is appropriately tested before release. Own functional acceptance, regression testing, release readiness and follow-through on defects. Define and execute product test scenarios, including validation of AI behaviour against expected outcomes. Shape and evaluate prompts, agents, AI workflows and model behaviour where these form part of the product experience. Make day-to-day product and delivery decisions, escalating material architectural or technical decisions where appropriate. Maintain delivery momentum and a clear view of priorities, risks, defects and upcoming releases. Product discovery and customer engagement Speak regularly with prospects, pilot users and customers to understand their problems, workflows and priorities. Lead or support product discovery sessions and use-case discussions. Demo product capabilities and new features in a pre-sales and product capacity. Distinguish repeatable product opportunities from one-off customer requests. Identify patterns across customer and prospect conversations and use them to recommend what should be built next. Bring evidence, feedback and product recommendations into the product-direction group. Experience and skills Around 2–3 years' relevant experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, technical product delivery, QA, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, automation, software engineering or a similar role. Strong ability to translate ambiguous customer and business problems into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria. Practical experience owning or contributing to product testing, QA, release validation or acceptance. Comfort working with modern AI development tools or AI-assisted software delivery processes. Enough technical understanding to investigate issues, assess implementation quality and challenge poor outcomes without needing to be a full-time software developer. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Comfort working with APIs, data flows, integrations and modern cloud application concepts. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence speaking directly with prospects and customers. Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and take ownership of delivery outcomes. What matters more than your previous job title You have strong product instincts and naturally focus on the customer problem before the solution. You can turn conversations and ambiguous feedback into clear, testable requirements. You care about quality and are comfortable owning acceptance and release readiness. You understand that AI-generated implementation still requires human judgement, testing and accountability. You are technically curious and comfortable working closely with an AI-enabled development lifecycle. You are equally comfortable discussing a customer use case and investigating why a feature is not behaving as expected. You enjoy operating in an experimental environment where the product is still being shaped. Desirable Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, prompt evaluation or AI workflow design. Experience in SaaS, workflow, process automation, compliance, risk or B2B enterprise software. Experience participating in product discovery or pre-sales technical conversations. Familiarity with agile product development, backlog management and release processes. Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools in a structured delivery environment. Career development As the product matures, this role has the potential to evolve towards broader AI Product Owner responsibility. The initial focus is deliberately hands-on: learning directly from the market while owning product quality and delivery. Right to work Candidates must already have the unrestricted right to work in the jurisdiction in which they will be employed. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Why FlowForma FlowForma is building AI into both its products and the way those products are developed. This role provides the opportunity to work directly on an emerging AI product, engage continuously with the market, and help shape a modern product-delivery model that combines strong Product Ownership, disciplined QA and AI-enabled software delivery.
title: AI Product & Delivery Specialist

description: Ecosystem and Fintech Growth Manager Send Application to jobs@lhoft.lu. This is an exciting opportunity to join the team at the Luxembourg House of Financial Technology (LHoFT) and to help drive meaningful change across Luxembourg's financial services ecosystem. This is a prominent role within the LHoFT, responsible for managing a key initiative on behalf of the Luxembourg Financial Centre. About the Role The Ecosystem and Fintech Growth Manager will report to the Head of Ecosystem and Partnerships and will work closely with the wider LHoFT team, in particular the Ecosystem team. The role holder will be responsible for business development, fintech incubation, and a range of programmes related to fintech scaling, funding schemes, startup support, and innovation projects, among others. This includes working with third-party institutions and government departments to follow up on action items and issues, maintain project progress reporting, and prepare supporting documentation. Key Responsibilities Business Development • Attract the most strategic fintechs to Luxembourg • Represent the LHoFT and the Luxembourg fintech ecosystem at international fairs and events • Take ownership of the execution of relevant fintech events, in Luxembourg and abroad, coordinating across all stakeholders to ensure success criteria are met • Connect innovative fintechs with the Luxembourg financial industry • Manage sales and budget activities, including sales pipeline management, oversight of budgets related to incubation and fintech membership, and consistent filing and reporting of project documentation Growing the Fintech Ecosystem • Contribute to the development of LHoFT's unique value proposition and differentiators, acting as a voice for the foundation and prioritising requests and ideas strategically to make well-informed recommendations • Work with the LHoFT team and relevant third parties to define objectives, success criteria, strategy, and plans for scaling fintechs • Foster cooperation between the broader Luxembourg ecosystem and relevant fintech stakeholders • Work with the Ecosystem and Innovation teams to ensure effective coordination and synergy between acceleration programmes and support for the fintech community • Act as the go-to resource for the LHoFT fintech community on matters of scaling, business development, and funding, working with Luxembourg-based and international stakeholders to enable startup growth Marketing and Promotion • Work with the Marketing team to plan and raise awareness of LHoFT's value proposition, including for sponsorship and applications • Work with the Marketing team to ensure effective event management where required • Protect the LHoFT brand and identity, ensuring consistency across all external touchpoints Running the LHoFT Incubator • Run the LHoFT incubation programme • Agree, report on, and achieve appropriate KPIs with the Head of Ecosystem and Partnerships International Partnerships • Develop and nurture international relationships with relevant fintech incubators and accelerators Team Collaboration and Support • Be a conscientious and respectful team player, working closely with the LHoFT team to achieve shared business objectives • Seek help when needed, remain open to input, act transparently, focus on solutions rather than issues, manage business risk, and treat others as you would wish to be treated • Support the LHoFT in meeting its responsibilities to stakeholders, stepping in for other team members where appropriate and helping ensure the LHoFT continues to deliver on expectations Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who brings most of the following: • A bachelor's degree in economics, business, or IT is an advantage • Knowledge of, or a genuine enthusiasm for, fintech • Relevant experience in sales and business development • Ability to multi-task and manage a range of projects simultaneously • Agility, with the ability to respond quickly to new priorities • An analytical and diligent approach to work • Demonstrable ability to influence others, build relationships with a wide variety of people, and position a case effectively to get things done • Willingness to learn new technologies and methods, and to develop new competencies • Creativity, in both ideas and execution • An organised, level-headed approach, able to assess situations and plan and implement actions in a constructive and logical way • Confidence to work autonomously, take responsibility, and make sound decisions • Willingness to ask for help or input to ensure the best outcomes • A collaborative mindset, involving others and drawing on their skills while contributing your own toward shared team goals • Demonstrable ability to execute and deliver results • Excellent written communication skills • Fluency in English and French, both spoken and written; Luxembourgish and German are an advantage What We Offer • A dynamic and exciting working environment • A role with strong purpose, impacting the lives of entrepreneurs and contributing to the future of Luxembourg's financial industry and its competitiveness on the world stage • Access to decision-makers across the financial industry • International experience and exposure • A competitive salary package How to Apply Please send your CV and a short covering email explaining why you are interested in the role and why you believe you are the right person for it to jobs@lhoft.lu. About the LHoFT Foundation The LHoFT Foundation is a public-private sector initiative dedicated to propelling Luxembourg to the forefront of financial technology innovation. At its core, the LHoFT champions the fusion of technology with financial services, fostering a network that spans local and global fintech communities and paving the way for cutting-edge solutions that will shape the financial services world of tomorrow. As a focal point for Luxembourg's financial technology ecosystem, the LHoFT cultivates meaningful connections across a broad range of stakeholders, including established financial institutions, pioneering fintech startups, the IT sector, academia, and regulatory bodies. The Foundation is supported by private sector partners such as BGL BNP Paribas, Clearstream (Deutsche Börse Group), and Société Générale, among others, with this support further strengthened by the Luxembourg government and the Chamber of Commerce. Joining the LHoFT means becoming part of an invigorating and inspiring work environment, engaging with a diverse range of professionals from the financial, governmental, advisory, and entrepreneurial sectors. Based in the vibrant House of Startups, our offices are a hub of innovation and excitement, ensuring that no two days are the same. We take pride in a culture that values fulfilment, achievement, and the continuous pursuit of excellence.
title: Ecosystem & Fintech Growth Manager

description: Wil jij bijdragen aan de groei van een internationaal travelmerk en ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer mensen hun weg naar hun ideale vakantie vinden? Dit zoeken we in jou 2+ jaar ervaring binnen digital marketing, growth, CRM, e-commerce of een vergelijkbare brede marketingrol Resultaatgericht, ondernemend en proactief Data-gedreven en nieuwsgierig naar klantgedrag en commerciële kansen Sterk in stakeholdermanagement en samenwerken met verschillende teams en partners Leergierig en altijd op zoek naar manieren om dingen slimmer en beter te doen Goed om te weten Vast dienstverband Amsterdam Tot €55K bruto per jaar inclusief vakantiegeld, o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring 40 uur per week 1 dag per week thuiswerken Over Vacanze col Cuore Bij Vacanze col Cuore geloven we dat vakantie meer is dan alleen een plek om te overnachten. Het gaat om vrijheid, buiten zijn, samen tijd doorbrengen en herinneringen maken. Met onze premium glampingresorts in Nederland en Italië combineren we de charme van vakantie in de natuur met comfort, service en bijzondere ervaringen. Ons verhaal begint bij een ondernemende familie die al tientallen jaren actief is in de reis- en recreatiebranche. Als pioniers zagen zij vroeg kansen in een nieuwe manier van vakantie vieren: dichter bij de natuur, maar zonder in te leveren op comfort. Vanuit die ondernemersmentaliteit is Vacanze col Cuore uitgegroeid tot een internationale organisatie met verschillende resorts en een sterke ambitie om verder te groeien. Die ondernemende spirit is nog steeds onderdeel van wie we zijn. We zijn groot genoeg om internationaal impact te maken, maar klein genoeg om snel te kunnen schakelen. Ideeën krijgen hier de ruimte en je krijgt de vrijheid om zelf initiatief te nemen, nieuwe dingen te testen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan onze groei. Onze gasten zijn net zo divers als hun manier van vakantie vieren. De ene klant plant maanden vooruit een zomervakantie in Italië, terwijl een ander spontaan op zoek gaat naar een last-minute getaway. Dat maakt onze marketing uitdagend én interessant. We werken met een seizoensgebonden product, verschillende doelgroepen, meerdere markten en een customer journey die al begint lang voordat een gast bij ons aankomt. Vanuit ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam werken we dagelijks aan één doel: ervoor zorgen dat onze gasten ons weten te vinden, enthousiast worden en uiteindelijk terugkomen voor hun volgende vakantie. Nederland, Italië en Duitsland zijn belangrijke markten voor ons, maar onze internationale ambities reiken verder. Ook het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Frankrijk, Polen, Tsjechië en Denemarken maken onderdeel uit van onze groeistrategie. De rol Als Digital & Growth Marketing Manager krijg je een brede, hands-on rol waarin digital marketing, CRM, data en commercie samenkomen. Je kijkt naar de volledige customer journey: van het eerste moment waarop iemand een van onze resorts ontdekt tot de boeking, het verblijf en uiteindelijk de volgende vakantie. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol ligt binnen CRM en retentie. Je gaat aan de slag met klantdata, segmentatie, marketing automation en customer lifecycle journeys. Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat een gast op het juiste moment wordt geïnspireerd voor een volgende vakantie? En hoe maken we van een eenmalige familievakantie een terugkerende klant? CRM & Performance vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk, maar je kijkt altijd naar het grotere geheel. Je houdt onze websites en booking journeys scherp in de gaten, analyseert campagnes en werkt aan e-mail, paid media, social en direct mail. Je kijkt daarbij niet alleen naar afzonderlijke kanalen, maar vooral naar hoe ze elkaar kunnen versterken en gezamenlijk bijdragen aan acquisitie, conversie en retentie. Je hoeft niet de specialist in ieder kanaal te zijn. Wel begrijp je hoe de verschillende onderdelen van digital marketing samenwerken en vind je het interessant om in de cijfers te duiken. Je vertaalt analyses naar concrete aanbevelingen, denkt mee over CRO en gebruikt learnings om campagnes en customer journeys steeds verder te verbeteren. Ook AI en automation krijgen een belangrijke plek binnen onze verdere ontwikkeling. We zijn benieuwd hoe nieuwe technologie ons kan helpen om analyses, processen en marketingactiviteiten slimmer en efficiënter te maken. Je hoeft hiervoor geen technische developer te zijn; nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken vinden we veel belangrijker. Je werkt daarnaast nauw samen met interne stakeholders, developers, externe digital experts en andere partners. Werkt iets niet zoals het hoort? Dan wacht je niet af, maar zoek je uit wat er nodig is en zorg je dat het wordt opgelost. En misschien wel het leukste: je werkt aan een product waarvan je het resultaat van je werk letterlijk kunt zien. Een campagne die goed werkt, betekent uiteindelijk dat iemand met zijn gezin geniet van een vakantie bij één van onze resorts. Om ons product, onze gasten en onze organisatie écht te leren kennen, krijg je bovendien meerdere keren per jaar de mogelijkheid om onze resorts in Italië te bezoeken. Dit breng je mee Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen digital marketing, growth, CRM, e-commerce of een vergelijkbare brede marketingrol. Je bent hands-on, commercieel en datagedreven en vindt het leuk om zelf dingen uit te zoeken en voor elkaar te krijgen. Je hebt ervaring met CRM en/of marketing automation en begrijpt de basis van analytics, SEO, conversie en paid media. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI, automation en nieuwe technologie en ziet kansen om processen slimmer te maken. Ervaring met GA4, Google Tag Manager en Looker Studio is een pré. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende interne en externe partijen. Je spreekt Nederlands en Engels. Duits of Italiaans is een mooie bonus. Ervaring binnen travel, hospitality, leisure of een andere multi-location consumeromgeving is een pré. Dit bieden we jou Een bruto jaarsalaris tot €55K inclusief vakantiegeld, op basis van 40 uur en afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een brede Digital & Growth-rol waarin je werkt met CRM, data, SEO, campagnes, CRO en automation. Veel vrijheid om nieuwe ideeën te testen en daadwerkelijk iets neer te zetten. De mogelijkheid om te werken aan meerdere Europese markten en verschillende doelgroepen. Een enthousiast en ambitieus team vanuit ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam. De mogelijkheid om meerdere keren per jaar onze glampingresorts in Italië te bezoeken. Korting op persoonlijke en familievakanties binnen Vacanze col Cuore. Een jaarlijks ontwikkel- en opleidingsbudget om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Een pensioenregeling en vakantiedagen conform de CAO Recreatie. Een reiskostenvergoeding of vergoeding voor het OV. Een fulltime functie met de mogelijkheid om één dag per week thuis te werken. Een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is, waar je direct invloed hebt op onze verdere groei. Veel ruimte om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan de volgende fase van Vacanze col Cuore?
title: Digital & Growth Marketing Manager | Travel | Internationale groei

description: D2C Business Manager | Bene Kleed Location: Bangalore | Full-time We’re looking for someone to run D2C like a business, not manage it like a website. At Bene Kleed, the D2C Business Manager owns the digital business end-to-end: traffic → conversion → net revenue → profitability. You will own the number. And everything required to deliver that number. What you’ll own Your primary responsibility is simple: Grow D2C revenue profitably. That means owning: D2C revenue and net sales vs plan Traffic and customer acquisition required to deliver the plan Performance marketing outcomes including CAC, ROAS and traffic quality Conversion rate and revenue per session AOV and product/category performance Website merchandising and customer journey New launch performance Pricing, promotions and discount effectiveness Gross margin and contribution margin Customer returns, cancellations and RTO Inventory availability for D2C CRM, retention and repeat-revenue opportunities Identifying and removing anything that is stopping the business from growing You don't need to personally execute everything. We have specialists across Growth, Brand, Creative, Planning, Design, CRM, CX, Tech and Operations. Your job is to make all these inputs come together to deliver the D2C plan. What ownership means here If traffic is below plan, you should know before the month ends . If CAC suddenly deteriorates, you should be asking why. If traffic is coming but conversion isn't, diagnose the funnel. If a bestseller is running out of stock, don't wait for Planning to tell you. If a campaign needs better creative, drive the requirement. If a product is selling well but coming back at a 40% return rate, that's not a success. If revenue is growing but contribution is collapsing, that's not healthy growth either. And if another team owns the corrective action, follow it through until it happens. A dependency is not an excuse. You should be obsessed with the numbers We expect you to understand the relationship between: Traffic × Conversion × AOV = Revenue But your job doesn't stop at gross revenue. You should think in: Net Revenue → Gross Margin → Returns → Discounts → Contribution Every week, you should be able to tell us: What happened? Why did it happen? What are we doing next? Without hiding behind a 40-slide presentation. Who we're looking for Someone who has genuinely worked on a D2C/e-commerce business and understands how the commercial engine works. You should be comfortable with: Shopify and e-commerce analytics Meta / Google performance marketing metrics CAC, ROAS and customer acquisition Conversion optimisation Product and category analytics Inventory and availability Returns and RTO CRM and retention Pricing and promotions Margins and contribution Building and working against a D2C business plan More importantly, you should be able to connect these numbers , not look at each one in isolation. Probably not for you if... You think D2C means updating banners and coupons on Shopify. You believe marketing's job ends at ROAS. You celebrate gross sales without looking at returns or margin. You wait for another department to tell you why the business missed its number. Or you need every function to report to you before you're willing to take accountability. We are not hiring a website manager. We are not hiring another performance marketer. We are hiring someone to own a business. About Bene Kleed Bene Kleed is an Indian streetwear brand built for people who don't want to look, think or dress like everyone else. We're ambitious about where we're going, and we're building a team that wants ownership, not just a designation. You don't run the website. You run the business that happens on it. Not For Everyone. If that's the kind of responsibility you're looking for, we'd like to hear from you.
